text:
OFFBOX::request
Description
This iRules command performs a request with a payload to certain service.
Syntax
OFFBOX
::
request
<
service
>
<
payload
>
[
cache
<
key
>
]
[[
blocking
]
[
timeout
]]
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
eq
"login.php"
}
{
OFFBOX
::
request
"/Common/offbox::ip_reputation"
[
TCP
::
client_addr
]
cache
[
TCP
::
client_addr
]
blocking
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL
